chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who bequeathed a portion of his wealth. He said: "It is one-seventh of his one-third."

key_terms.بِجُزْءٍ: a portion or part specified in a bequest
key_terms.ثُلُثِهِ: his one-third share allowed for bequest

ai.seo_question: What does "a portion of his wealth" mean in a bequest according to Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the meaning of bequeathing a "portion" of one’s wealth in a will. The Imam عليه السلام explains that this portion is calculated as one-seventh of the one-third share that may be disposed of through bequest.
